doc: Which Agent-tool model overrides scripts/hooks/guard-agent-model.sh denies unless the dispatch prompt carries an `ESCALATION: <reason>` line. Documented in docs/internals/enforcement.md.
why: Opus 5.5 high is the judge default: about $8.23 vs $21.94 per verdict with no missed finding. An in-process Agent call passing `model: fable` silently overrides the judge agent's `model: opus` frontmatter (judge.md; old ids console-judge*), so the policy is structural rather than prose.

Today there is no standing case for Fable. A newer Fable model is expected: this file is the ONE place the block lives, so unblocking or re-targeting a model is a one-line reviewed change here, not a hook rewrite.

semantics.blocked_model_patterns: case-insensitive (input is lowercased) regexes, tested against the Agent call's `model`. A match is denied unless the prompt has an acceptable ESCALATION line. Remove an entry to unblock that model; an empty list blocks nothing.
semantics.warn_model_patterns: case-insensitive regexes tested against the `model` of any Agent dispatch whose subagent_type is not a judge (untyped, general-purpose or a named helper agent). A match WARNS (additionalContext, exit 0, never a deny) unless the prompt has a `TIER: <reason>` line that passes the same min_reason_chars / placeholder_reasons test as ESCALATION (chief Opus helpers cost $41-eq/day). A policy without the key warns on nothing.
semantics.default_sonnet_agent_types: subagent_type values (lowercased; the empty string is an untyped dispatch) whose helpers default to Sonnet 5.5. A dispatch of such a type whose `model` matches warn_model_patterns is DENIED, not warned, unless the prompt has a usable `TIER: <reason>` or `ESCALATION: <reason>` line. Named agents not listed here (ticket-auditor, page-reviewer, brief-drafter, edit-runner) keep the warn. A policy without the key denies nothing on this rule.
semantics.min_reason_chars: an ESCALATION reason shorter than this (after trimming) is treated as no reason.
semantics.placeholder_reasons: reasons rejected outright. The reason is lowercased, every run of non-alphanumerics becomes one space, then compared, so `N/A.` matches `n a`.
semantics.not_covered: a judge dispatch (old ids console-judge*) whose model is not opus stays denied by the hook itself (its frontmatter tier, not a model name); the same ESCALATION rule applies.
